name: 21-mirror-coverage-order-client-first
why: Stage 4.5 ordering. Client (evaluated FIRST) is stopped out of p1 (BUY 1 @1.20000, bid 1.10000: equity -9900 on 1100 margin, -900%). p1 is mirrored (SOURCE_PRICE) onto master's t1 (SELL 1 @1.00000) and hedged by the auto-hedged leg1 (BUY 1 @1.20020) on the coverage account. Web: mirror + coverage run inside the pass, so t1 closes at the SOURCE price 1.10000 (-10000, 'Mirror close') and leg1 at bid 1.10000 (-10020, 'Coverage auto-close') BEFORE master and cover are evaluated; both then have nothing open. The engine used to evaluate master / cover before its outbox ran and stop them out itself (t1 at ask 1.10020 = -10020, 'Stop-out'): the divergence. Now the engine defers an account a pending follow-up will touch, so both match.
